prompt: This children's picture book illustration presents a friendly car repair garage with bold outlines and flat colors. In the center, a smiling mechanic in blue overalls lifts the hood of a red car, revealing a simple engine block. To the left, a child in a yellow shirt points at the engine, looking curious and excited. On the right, a toolbox sits open on the floor, containing a wrench, a screwdriver, and a rag. A fluffy white cat sleeps on top of a tire stack in the foreground, unaware of the activity. Behind the car, shelves hold oil cans and spare parts in bright primary colors. A large clock on the back wall shows the time as noon. Sunlight streams in through a high window, illuminating the clean, organized space. The mechanic gestures toward the engine, explaining its function to the child. The interaction is educational and warm, fostering a sense of wonder about how things work. The composition is balanced, with the car anchoring the center and the characters framing it on either side. The simple shapes and cheerful palette make the scene inviting and easy to understand for young readers, emphasizing learning and cooperation in a safe environment.
